headline: Events Coordinator
summary: Events coordinator with three years organising festivals, weddings and corporate events in Camarines Norte. I coordinate suppliers, programs and venues, take part in the province's tourism events, and design the promotional materials that bring people in. Guests' experience on the day is what I care about most.

experience.title: Events Coordinator
experience.employer: Bicol Coastline Events and Tourism Services
experience.paragraph: Coordinate about 40 events a year, from beach weddings to company outings and festival activities.
bullets: Plan timelines, suppliers and budgets and run each event on the day.
Organise the company's booths and activities during the Pinyasan Festival and surfing competitions.
Design posters and social media promos in Canva for public events.
Welcome VIP guests and look after them throughout the program.

experience.title: Events Assistant
bullets: Set up venues and coordinated caterers and sound suppliers.
Kept event checklists and supplier contacts up to date.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management
